title: Turkey Shepherd's Pie with Two-Potato Topping
ingredients: 1.5 lbs ground turkey or chopped roast turkey
1 lb Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cubed + 1 lb sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed (two-potato topping)
3 tbsp unsalted butter + 1/3 cup warm milk or sour cream (for mash)
1 large onion, diced; 2 carrots, diced; 2 celery stalks, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced & 1 tbsp chopped fresh thyme/sage
2 tbsp tomato paste & 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
1.5 cups turkey or chicken broth + 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
instructions: Boil the Yukon Gold potatoes and sweet potatoes together in salted water for 15–18 minutes until tender; drain and mash with butter, warm milk, salt, and pepper into a vibrant two-potato mash.
In a large oven-safe skillet, brown the ground turkey with onion, carrots, celery, mushrooms, garlic, and herbs for 8–10 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and flour, cook 1 minute, then whisk in broth and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer 5 minutes until thickened, then fold in peas.
Top with the swirled Yukon Gold and sweet potato mash and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25–30 minutes until bubbling and golden around the edges.
